_what: Known gaps in the locked NavBlue OFP parser (D47). The FlightKeys airport-text section and the import-platform detector section were removed at step 5e-1 (the module switch): the FlightKeys parser now supplies every FlightKeys airport's NOTAM and weather text (test/unit/v0-invariants.test.js checks it), and the app's detector (src/ofp-parse.html, O-78; test/unit/detector.test.js) classifies all 56 fixtures.

navblue-parser._what: Known gaps in the NavBlue OFP parser (rules/ofp-navblue/ofp-navblue-v2.0.1.js). The parser is locked (D47; Exec decision 13 Nov): these are recorded, not fixed. Fix at the next NavBlue unlock; the FlightKeys parser implements the correct rule (5b).
navblue-parser._rule: test/unit/deval-dates.test.js TC-140-002 expects the listed fixtures of G-NB-1 to have no departure airport and no OUT time, and FAILS if any other fixture has no OUT time or if a listed one fails in another way; it prints a REMINDER when a listed fixture has its OUT time (then delete it from the list).

gaps.what: An airport line (ORIG, DEST, alternates) with no 3-letter code after the slash is skipped: the pattern needs at least one non-space character after the slash.
gaps.effect: ORIG line skipped: no departure airport, no departure card, no OUT time (and so no dated timeline).
gaps.fix: fix at next NavBlue unlock; FlightKeys parser implements the correct rule (5b)

gaps.what: Date fallback: when there is no DOF/YYMMDD, the first "DD MON YY" anywhere in the text is taken as the flight date, with no word boundary and no check that it is a real date.
gaps.effect: An OFP without DOF can get a wrong or impossible flight date (e.g. day 59), which moves or drops the dated OUT time and every downline time.
gaps.fix: fix at next NavBlue unlock; FlightKeys parser implements the correct rule (5b)

gaps.what: E-WINS window (NB-F6): the window is built from the WSITAF validity DDHH/DDHH as "HH00Z-HH00Z", dropping the days; a forecast valid 24 h or more gives equal hours (e.g. 0812/0912 -> "1200Z-1200Z").
gaps.effect: src/airports.html line 297 uses ewinsWindow in place of the airport's window, so the E-WINS forecast is read at one hour (or a wrong span) instead of ETA ± 60 and the airport's role windows.
gaps.fix: fix at next NavBlue unlock; the FlightKeys parser returns ewinsWindow '' (Exec D66, ofp-flightkeys v0.3.0)

gaps.what: E-WINS role (NB-F7): the role is taken from the free-text line after the E-WINS header (/ALTERNATE/ -> ALT, else /DESTINATION|DEST/ -> DEST, else ALT), not from the airport's role in the release; a departure or any other role becomes ALT.
gaps.effect: ewinsRole can name the wrong role (the app stores it only today).
gaps.fix: fix at next NavBlue unlock; the FlightKeys parser returns the airport's actual role codes (Exec D66, ofp-flightkeys v0.3.0)

gaps.what: Curfew local-time bracket (NB-F8): a SUMMER / WINTER curfew line is kept whole, its local-time bracket included (e.g. '(2300-0700 LCL)'); the app's curfew reader (src/render-descent.html parseCurfewWindows) then reads the local times as a second UTC window.
gaps.effect: A false curfew window at the local times (EHAM: 2300-0700 read as UTC) can colour a curfew red or yellow when the ETA is outside the real UTC window.
gaps.fix: fix at next NavBlue unlock; the FlightKeys parser drops the LCL bracket (Exec O-35, ofp-flightkeys v0.4.0)
